title: Preparation and culture of cytotrophoblasts
protocol: Isolate placental tissue from ice-cold saline.
Rinse placental tissue with PBS.
Remove soft villous material from connective tissue and vessels.
Incubate villous tissue in HBSS containing 0.125% trypsin type XII-S, 3 mM EDTA, and 0.2 mg/ml deoxyribonuclease I at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge the incubated tissue to isolate dissociated cells.
Resuspend isolated cells in medium.
Layer cells over a discontinuous Percoll gradient (15% to 70%) prepared in HBSS.
Collect middle bands of the gradient (35% to 55%), containing cytotrophoblasts.
Wash collected cytotrophoblasts several times with culture media (DMEM:F12 in a 1:1 ratio and 15% heat-inactivated FCS).
Remove remaining leukocytes from the cells.
Maintain cell cultures in culture media at 37°C and 5% CO₂ in a humidified incubator.
Plate trophoblasts on 24 well plates precoated with 75% growth factor reduced Matrigel.
Incubate plated trophoblasts in media as described above.
After 5 days, remove trophoblasts by scraping the plates.
Treat removed cells with trypsin-EDTA and use for analysis.
Obtain decidual samples.
Trim decidual samples into 1mm pieces.
Enzymatically digest the trimmed samples for 20 minutes by shaking in 37°C with 1.5 mg type I DNase and 24 mg type IV collagenase in 15 ml of RPMI-1640 medium.
Repeat enzymatic digestion three times.
Collect supernatants after each digestion round.
Centrifuge the collected supernatants.
Incubate overnight in tissue culture dishes in DMEM medium with supplements.
Remove non-adherent cells from the incubated samples.
Treat remaining adherent cells with trypsin-EDTA for a short period.
Sort purified HLA-G+ extra-villous trophoblasts from adherent decidual fraction using monoclonal mouse anti-human HLA-G specific antibodies.
Perform intracellular staining on purified trophoblasts with Cytofix-cytoperm kit.
Stain cells with mouse anti-human Cytokeratin 7 and mouse anti-human vimentin antibodies.
Include matching isotype controls for antibody specificity.
